environment.filesystem: operator workspace on local macOS volume; OS page cache not purged

structuralGates.projection: page before recursive projection; no off-page tree projection
structuralGates.client: one in-flight update and one schedule per canonical key/store instance

decisions.recordCache: per-file cache plus immutable generation snapshot in the existing Python API process
decisions.changeFingerprint: directory scan with file identity and metadata including inode, size, mtime_ns and ctime_ns; read, hash and parse the same bytes only for visible deltas; bounded stat/read/stat retry
decisions.integrityLimit: metadata-invisible bit changes cannot be detected without reopening bodies; exact cryptographic verification on every request conflicts with the zero-body-read warm gate and is not claimed
decisions.liveRepresentation: additive view=live on the existing status path, with default compatibility retained
decisions.executionRepresentation: additive page summary; full detail remains by ticket id
decisions.client: small canonical-key store with shared promise, subscribers, data plus error, freshness and bounded inactive entries
decisions.worktrees: reuse a per-request-generation inventory; preserve live action revalidation and existing du coalescing

knownLinearCosts: directory metadata scan remains O(N) until measured evidence justifies a different change source
ledger overlay may remain O(N) in memory after ledger mutation
cold rebuild remains proportional to retained records
measurementGapsAtLock: compiled-browser render/layout, two-tab and 100-remount traces remain for integrated proof
DWT Git/du latency and full child CPU accounting remain for integrated proof
cold login and installed-Mac performance are S6-only and bootObserved is false
